name: Yan Tat Group Holdings Limited
summary: Yan Tat Group Holdings Limited, established in 1989 and headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company and subsidiary of Million Pearl Holdings Ltd. that makes and distributes printed circuit boards worldwide, also trading them and holding property. Its customers span mainland China, Europe, Hong Kong, Asia, North America, Africa, Oceania and South America, in automotive, telecommunications, medical, industrial automation and consumer electronics.
